payload.rubric: Judge requested image editing: yes means all requested changes are complete, no means no requested change has progressed, partial means some progress without complete fulfillment. Unrelated edits are not requested progress. Insufficient evidence stays unresolved.

node.question: Is a helmet visibly present on the woman’s head?
node.criteria: For R1: complete if s1 passes, regardless of s2. If s1 fails, partial only if s2 passes and thereby establishes visible helmet-related progress that is not complete; absent if s1 and s2 both fail. If s1 is unknown, or the available observations otherwise do not establish one of these states, unknown. A transport or call failure is not visual evidence and remains unresolved. Unrelated edits do not count as progress.
node.binding: Target: The woman is wearing or otherwise visibly has a helmet on her head.. Reference: The woman in the input image..
